units.function: Embedded-Postgres integration suite for Company Skill test inputs/templates/runs, Issue-backed harness cleanup, version and configuration snapshots, supersession, retention, cancellation/deletion and rich artifact hydration.
units.dependencyDirection: The suite calls companySkillService directly, supplies Issue lifecycle callbacks, persists real Company/Agent/Skill/Issue/Document/Asset/Work Product rows and uses a temporary local Skill directory; route authorization, the real Agent adapter and execution sandbox are outside scope.
units.keyDataModels: Company, local Skill, Codex Agent config, test input/template/snapshot/version/run, superseded and terminal states, harness Issue retention, output Document, SHA-bearing Attachment, Work Product and compatibility artifact projections.
units.lifecycle: Seed tenant/Skill/Agent; create or snapshot a template and version; create the harness Issue; persist and wake a queued run; supersede/start/complete/cancel/delete it; snapshot output/cost/config; hydrate Issue artifacts; hide expired harness content while retaining run history.
units.testAssessment: The 12 tests are readable and behavior-oriented, with strong tenant binding, reproducible snapshots, stale-event rejection, terminal-only deletion, pre-commit cleanup, retention and rich Issue-scoped artifact assertions. Focused Vitest was attempted in the sandbox and twice outside it with fresh isolated homes; all 12 were skipped because embedded PostgreSQL could not start, so 0 runtime tests passed on this host. Missing coverage includes actual sandbox/capability isolation, secret redaction, wake/cancel compensation, terminal races, client snapshot authenticity, permission roles, pagination and accountable approval/evidence.
units.designRationale: Treat a Skill test as a reproducible Issue-backed task whose inputs, selected Skill version, Agent configuration, template and outputs remain inspectable after transient task artifacts are pruned.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs deterministic evaluation runs that prove the exact package, sanitized runtime configuration, Agent/Connector attestation, permissions/data used, approvals, evidence and result without invoking production side effects or retaining secrets.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the tenant-isolation, pinned-version, snapshot, superseded-event, retention and artifact-projection test cases into Company OS compatibility tests. Replace prompt-only sandbox assumptions with enforced execution profiles and add secret-canary, signed provenance, approval/data-egress, idempotency, failure-compensation and concurrency cases.
units.responsibilityConflict: The suite calls the harness 'sandboxed' but never invokes or constrains a real runtime. It accepts caller-provided template snapshots, expects configuration snapshots without asserting redaction and does not bind the run to an accountable human, approved action digest, permissions/data contract or runtime proof.
evidence: b13eb5b2b5cc7ad721f96b914c55dad9e66c5f81 Skill Studio: three-pane skill IDE with sandboxed test runs (#9241)
focused Vitest: 1 file and 12 tests skipped; embedded PostgreSQL failed after five attempts in two escalated fresh-home runs; 0 passed
securityFindings: No test seeds credential canaries in adapterConfig/runtimeConfig or asserts a secret-free persisted snapshot; objectContaining allows arbitrary extra sensitive fields.
No test proves network, shell, filesystem, enterprise-system or durable side effects are denied; safety text in the harness prompt is not execution isolation.
Caller-supplied templateSnapshot is treated as historical truth without a test binding it to a prior run or immutable digest.
Post-commit wake failure, external cancel failure, concurrent terminal transitions and cleanup retries are untested.
Rich artifacts are tenant/Issue scoped, but tests do not cover authorization/redaction, untrusted content, evidence signatures or accountable-human approval.
